title: Elytrapark
description: A simple datapack about doing tricks with an Elytra, inspired by the likes of Tony Hawk Pro Skater. Applicable to any world.
body:
Elytrapark is a simple minigame about getting a high score by doing tricks. Simply put, Tony Hawk Pro Skater, but with Minecraft Elytras. Amplified world recommended.

You have tricks and failtricks, a combo level and combo health, and a few tools at your disposal. Everything is made specifically to encourage the funnest gameplay possible.

Each combo score is added to your total so that you can flex on your friends. Also comes with advancements.


There will be a discord soon :)
